{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify number of unique patients after deduplication
num_unique_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {num_unique_patients}')

# Check for confounding: crosstab of severity by arm
crosstab_severity_arm = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['severity'], df_dedup['arm'])
print('Crosstab of severity by arm (after deduplication):')
print(crosstab_severity_arm)

# Compute response rate by arm
response_rates = df_dedup.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
treatment_response_rate = response_rates['treatment']
control_response_rate = response_rates['control']
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

print(f'Treatment response rate: {treatment_response_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Control response rate: {control_response_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect:.4f}')"}
